title: Canonical saved configuration object declarations
description: Structural description of canonical object declarations for runtime config_schema_version 1. This schema document has an independent identity. Defaults are annotations, never instructions to insert declarations. Legacy permissive Serde positional arrays are outside this canonical form; the loader is unchanged. Schema success is not complete parser, semantic, filesystem, credential or runtime admission.
$comment: One JSON document within the saved 1 MiB byte bound is required. Duplicate members, lexical integer tokens (1.0 is not an integer token for the Rust parser), UTF8 byte lengths, trimmed nonempty values, UUID parsing/nil/identity checks, cross-field memory/sync rules, safe roots/permissions/ownership, credentials and runtime activation remain existing typed/parser checks. JSON Schema maxLength counts Unicode code points, not UTF8 bytes. No format annotation grants path or credential authority.

config_schema_version.description: Runtime configuration version; independent of this schema document identity. Plain integer token required by existing parser.

model.description: Existing trimmed nonempty and UTF8 byte bounds remain authoritative.

base_url.description: Nonsecret declaration; this is not an endpoint validity/provider connectivity claim.

model_credential.description: Protected credential reference name only; no credential bytes or authority.

paths.description: Missing whole paths uses platform defaults; a present object requires all three strings. Absolute/nonoverlapping/owned/symlink-safe roots require filesystem validation.

sync.description: Missing members use existing SyncPolicy defaults. Collection, selected-memory and namespace relationships remain typed semantic checks.

memory.description: Profile required when enabled; selected profile matching and selected/sync eligibility remain typed semantic checks.

personalization.description: Existing text limit is16384 UTF8 bytes, not code points; this structural maxLength is necessary but insufficient for multibyte input.

research_policy.description: Absent/null means effective required. Absent versus explicitly null declarations are preserved by typed edits; no default is inserted.

anyOf.description: Absent/null/empty/version-only/partial object is valid. Present leaves cannot be null. Effective defaults are not newly saved declarations; backend preference is not account/destination configuration.

product_settings.description: Absent and explicit null parent remain distinct declarations even though both use effective defaults.

uuid.description: Existing UUID parsing and nonnil/identity checks remain required. Accepted saved spellings include canonical/uppercase, compact, urn:uuid and braced forms; this schema does not impose a narrower format annotation.
